## BUILD 35 AUDIT MANAGER — AUTHORITATIVE NO-RETEST / COMPLETED-WORK HANDOFF (2026-11-03)

**Owner instruction:** conserve audit compute. The purpose of this register is to distinguish work **already executed**, work **proposed for matrix credit but not yet adjudicated**, and work **actually outstanding**. It supplements and supersedes any older #646 note that inaccurately describes an already-deployed backend migration or a merged PR as still pending. **Read this register BEFORE launching tests, writing fixes or copying old outstanding queues.**

### 1. ALREADY EXECUTED — DO NOT RE-RUN. Judge original matrix evidence only.

**#702 A2 — COMPLETE/CLOSED, four independent evidence batches.** [Issue #702](https://github.com/kscanaiapp/kscan-app/issues/702), final evidence [`audit/a2-reconcile-batch1` @ `f829360c`](https://github.com/kscanaiapp/kscan-app/tree/f829360c/audit/a2). Tested mobile `2c2c9da4`; original matrix `49ab7fad` (138 PASS /1 FAIL /2957 NT snapshot).
- Receipt `purchase-import-extract`: 19/19 actual-handler Deno, 16/16 baseline; 28 cases mapped; **15 source PASS proposals, 8 N/A proposals (one conditional), 5 NT**. Ledger `audit/a2/out/a2-batch1-ledger.json`.
- Live VTO: 9/9 new +56/56 retained, mutation-tested; **6 firm PASS, 7 analog PASS requiring ruling, 20 construction-based N/A requiring ruling, 6 NT**. Ledger `audit/a2/out/a2-batch2-ledger.json`. The 4 device-excluded cells are NOT PASS.
- StyleChat `stylechat-generate`: 24/24 Deno, 10/11 mutations detected (one equivalent); **20 firm PASS, 2 analog requiring ruling, 12 NT**. Ledger `audit/a2/out/a2-batch3-ledger.json`.
- `style-outfit-generate`: 26/26 Deno, 22/24 mutations detected (two equivalent); **21 firm PASS, 2 analog requiring ruling, 2 construction N/A requiring ruling, 9 NT**. Ledger `audit/a2/out/a2-batch4-ledger.json`.
- **Aggregate across four disjoint batches: 73 proposed source PASS (11 analog requiring ruling) and 30 proposed N/A (require rulings).** These are proposals, NOT already accepted official matrix counts. Do NOT re-execute those successful handlers, suites, mutations, or the retained 886 source execution records merely to assign status. Check each original case's source equivalence and limitations instead.
- Open hypotheses (NOT proven defects): unusable receipt-provider output consuming billable allowance; malformed product placeholder/confidence 0; corrupt JPEG header-positive content; failed StyleChat/outfit generation consuming daily quota; requestId/idempotency/default duplicate spend; outfit prompt delimiter spoof and output reason display; temporary profile failure misreported as deletion. **Evaluate intent/severity first** before any targeted new reproducer; do not declare failures by analogy.

**#704 A4 — COMPLETE/CLOSED.** [Source-only RevenueCat/K+ evidence](https://github.com/kscanaiapp/kscan-app/tree/13edac609c269098d5c6f00cfdf8a7b1ab234e7d/docs/release/evidence/issue704), closed evidence PR #709. 19/19 real handler/webhook Deno tests with synthetic authorities, 5/5 disposable PostgreSQL interleavings, six prior-cell reviews; 17 artifact hashes verified. Tested mobile `2c2c9da4` and backend `2846fd14`; original-cell proposal **20 source PASS /5 NT over 25 distinct IDs**; five SQL concurrency outcomes are supplemental, not five extra mandatory PASS. Existing 36 K+ composed cases and 46 Staging records reused. **NO RE-RUN of webhook/actor/SQL tests.** This is *not* proof of store sandbox purchase/restore or Production webhook configuration. PR #709 was closed UNMERGED intentionally: evidence retained, no product repair.

**#705 A7 — FUNCTIONAL TEST BATCH COMPLETE; issue may remain open until repair merges.** [14-case detailed ledger](https://github.com/kscanaiapp/kscan-app/issues/705#issuecomment-6611030602); tested mobile `23aff72f`, backend `0bed36cc`; real mounted app client/hooks with stubbed network (not physical devices). Eight new Packing tests; 76/76 baseline, 232 related, Deno 92; six new commerce tests, 587 related; 47/47 Black-owned backend tests, TypeScript clean. **Five user-facing failures confirmed**: four Packing categories (non-2xx envelope, futile daily retry, aborted timeout misleading message, failed refresh narrated as plan) in **PR #711 OPEN/UNMERGED**; one shopping OS-link failure in **PR #712 MERGED** `8c0cd775`. No reason to rerun mounted suites. Watchlist scheduler #688 is *owner-config BLOCKED* and lower priority. **Local `A7-PK-*` and `A7-CM-*` labels are NOT original mandatory 3,096 matrix IDs**; match original cells before granting credit. #711 red security promotion gate is specifically `missing check: Contract tests`, an operational CI artifact issue, not a proven Packing logic failure. Do not merge until green.

### 2. ALREADY SOURCE-CLOSED OR GOVERNED-DEPLOYED BACKEND/INTEGRATION — DO NOT REIMPLEMENT

- **F025 receipt settlement authority:** canonical + mobile source repairs #685/#686 MERGED. **Migration `20261103011431` applied ONCE in Staging and Production** through governed runs [41646886149](https://github.com/kscanaiapp/kscan-app/actions/runs/41646886149) and [41648252306](https://github.com/kscanaiapp/kscan-app/actions/runs/41648252306). Deployed `purchase-import-extract` JWT-gated in both; old authenticated `complete_provider_request` and `release_provider_request` privileges revoked; `settle_provider_request_for_actor` service-role-only. **Do not replay migration, retest the complete settlement matrix, or redeploy as an audit prerequisite.** Receipt extraction kill switch remains OFF; app consent/feature activation is separate #706.
- **Gemini v2 processing consent:** migration `20261029184000` applied in both through governed workflow. Actual gated Elise and Scanner functions redeployed **both environments** (Production gated run [41657421889](https://github.com/kscanaiapp/kscan-app/actions/runs/41657421889) / [41657836174](https://github.com/kscanaiapp/kscan-app/actions/runs/41657836174)); Staging withdrawal -> 403 before Gemini, 0 calls; earlier v2 receipt grant/withdraw/stale/cross-user tested, Production auth/consent SQL 9/9. Staging Elise brand voice `enabled=true attached=true`, positive on-voice advice; Scanner image-mission `enabled=true attached=true`, hoodie with visible `COQ` wordmark identified; Staging MODE B three-offer shopping canary already executed [41667133409](https://github.com/kscanaiapp/kscan-app/actions/runs/41667133409). **Do not repeat paid Gemini calls, image-prompt canary or deployed consent checks.** Current v1-only installed builds remain unable to consent v2; activation/native user journey tracked in #706, NOT a re-audit of consent source.
- **Saved Scans:** `20261031162813` active-account guard and `20261102125053` owned restore migrations applied in BOTH via governed Staging/Production workflow; Production run examples [41673515951](https://github.com/kscanaiapp/kscan-app/actions/runs/41673515951), [41674858655](https://github.com/kscanaiapp/kscan-app/actions/runs/41674858655). Existing restoration policy equivalence and rollback-only Staging 8/8 retained. **No repeat DDL/migration or standard replay tests.**
- **Black-owned Discovery:** moderation schema already applied; `black-owned-discovery` AND `black-owned-catalog-sync` Edge functions ACTIVE in BOTH environments. Empty database (zero verified brands/products/eligible merchant products) is a real future merchant-onboarding/data state, **NOT an infrastructure deployment blocker**. #705 proved empty/failure shelf leaves primary shopping intact. **Do not seed fake merchants, repeat 47/47 backend empty-catalog suite, or block infrastructure merely for missing merchant inventory.** Scheduler PR #694 may still require owner secrets/environment setup and governed review.
- **Prior source repairs:** all **24 confirmed P0–P3** findings source-closed; B004 Scanner authenticated null-body guard #698/#699 CLOSED; W1 Watchlist malformed Expo ticket #689/#687 CLOSED; prior K+ D009/D021 source repairs CLOSED. #707 Gemini denial UX MERGED; #708 Android Voice Scan Settings MERGED `c6872c5a`; #712 Scanner commerce CTA MERGED `8c0cd775`. **Do not reopen these closed defects or rerun their large acceptance suites without a new concrete regression.**
- **W2 Watchlist E027** is the important exception: canonical #700 MERGED, mobile **#691 OPEN/DRAFT** and historically original failure `B35-MAND-0141` remains unresolved until mobile green merge/post-evidence. #711 and #691 both alter generated premium fingerprints; preserve BOTH governed identities at convergence. These source-integration merges are NOT a reason to hold independent audit-reconciliation.

### 3. NOT DONE — do NOT report as PASS, and keep the correct owner

- **#703 A5 is NOT complete.** It has a newly authorized **≤10 residual original privacy/image cells** (sanitizer/raw image transport, actor-switch, cache/retry leakage, withdrawal race). Agent may run *only* this narrow batch with synthetic inputs; no rerun of Gemini canary / consent migration / complete H003 sweep; Codex stays matrix owner.
- **RevenueCat Production webhook recovery**: protected run [41678583997](https://github.com/kscanaiapp/kscan-app/actions/runs/41678583997) reported `critical_recovery_failure`; prior older bundle active on last readback. **NOT CERTIFIED** new deployed Production webhook; recovery and authorized sandbox webhook event routing are **Activation #706**, not #704 repeat tests. RC project has a Production-only webhook integration; Staging sandbox delivery/auth configuration remains outstanding. No Production actions by audit lane.
- **Receipt Intelligence user-facing activation:** kill switch OFF despite F025 security deployment; v2-consent/feature enablement remains #706.
- **#711 Packing**: source repair locally green, but PR not merged (security gate reports missing `Contract tests` check), thus not source-closed on mobile authority. **#691 W2** similarly draft/pending required gate. Neither should be assumed PASS.
- **Native iOS/Android user journeys and store sandbox payments:** not evidenced by those synthetic tests. Owner has said device tests need not block normal source repair; do not translate that into false native PASS. #706 owns platform artifacts/releases, with its explicit current build-artifact hold until separately lifted.

### 4. CODEX NEXT ACTION (NO NEW WIDE TEST CAMPAIGN)

1. **Read real artifact ledgers first**, then adjudicate original-cell PASS vs analog vs N/A vs NT; compare source SHA and actor/fixture/scope; compute before/after arithmetic; retain all original historical failures. #702/#704/#705 cases are complete execution, not a request to run them again. Do not count batch suite totals as matrix coverage.
2. Resolve *only* narrow disputed original-cell mappings and reproducible release-critical hypotheses (provider quota charging, prompt containment, real privacy race); no speculative standalone findings, no duplicating #703.
3. Execute at most **10–20 genuinely uncovered original release-critical cases in one batch**, only AFTER dedup, and stop at an evidence checkpoint. Never launch 11,000-test broad regression simply to begin. A targeted regression after new source patch/merge is allowed; do not weaken existing protection.
4. Update existing PR #646 and original matrix in an isolated audit worktree only upon verified source-equivalence; keep PR #646 DRAFT. Only source-fix PRs with fully green required CI can merge into their correct authority. Keep Production changes and platform builds with their separate owners.

**No-repeat register means “do not waste compute on already completed proof”, not “skip a new regression if source changes invalidate evidence” and not “mark unexecuted work PASS.”**
